test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:
"Leave one in the lurch"

options.text: To abandon someone at a difficult time
To give someone a surprise gift
To take credit for someone's work

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. To abandon someone at a difficult time**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"Leave one in the lurch"** means to abandon someone who is in a difficult or problematic situation, especially when they need help the most. (किसी को मुश्किल समय में अकेला छोड़ देना)
 
 
• **Example:** When her business partner walked out, she was left in the lurch to handle everything on her own.
 
 
• This idiom is often used to describe a situation where someone is betrayed or deserted unexpectedly during tough times.
